scientific_integrity: The oracle shift follows from an exact quadratic risk expansion and a closed normal positive-part expectation; monotonicity is analytic. The crossover root is the only numerical component, and its uniqueness is proved before numerical evaluation. The bundled script only replays the formulas.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to two independent Gaussian observations with common known variance and squared-error loss. It characterizes the constant-shift class and the boundary-shift versus usual-estimator crossover, not the globally best equivariant estimator. A highly relevant 1968 source could not be inspected in full, leaving a stated bibliographic risk.
title: Closed-form oracle shifts for estimating the larger of two Gaussian means
